question: In which of the following cities of Haryana is Sheikh Chaheli’s Tomb located?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Kurukshetra__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sheikh Chaheli's Tomb is located in Kurukshetra city of Haryana.
 
• This tomb is also known as** the "Taj of Haryana"**.
 
• This tomb was built in **1650 AD**.
 
• This tomb was built by **Darashikoh** in memory of the famous Sufi saint Sheikh Chehli.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sufi Saint Abdul-Karim Abd-ur-Razak; popularly known by the name of Sheikh Chaheli.
 
• He was a Qadiriyya Sufi, he was **known for his wisdom and generosity**. 
 
• He was the master of Mughal Prince Dara Shikoh (A.D. 1650).
